t: This is the story of Westminster Hospital, which was founded in 1719 and has now closed. A medical school was attached to it, formally founded in 1834. A new hospital and school opened on Horseferry Road in 1939. The hospital closed in 1994, and its resources moved to the Chelsea and Westminster Hospital on Fulham Road. Clement Attlee died here. He was Prime Minister from 1945 to 1951 and is still the longest-serving Labour leader. Airey Neave, the MP who was assassinated in 1979, also died here. The actor Harry Hadden-Paton, known for Downton Abbey and The Crown, was born here.
